[*]Fixed a bug where 2 secret achievements could be attained in boss rush
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Improved default controller bindings
[*]Improved UI navigation when using keyboard or a controller
[*]Added glyphs for keys and Xbox One controller buttons to replace text prompts when applicable
[*]Key/button is now displayed alongside the icon when a new ability is unlocked
[*]Added a tutorial sequence for new players
[*]Removed unused clutter from the key rebinder
[*]Improved the calibration UI greatly
[*]Loading screen has been added to the boot process
[*]Fixed a rare bug where leaderboard download would fail
[*]Fixed bugs relating to the leaderboard button
[*]Fixed a bug where the back button (B on Xbox One) could not be rebinded
[*]Fixed a bug where the pause menu would have no default button selected
[/list]
